title: Complete gopls worktree live proof after PR #8049
body: Run the three live gopls workspace proofs required by #961 after the managed daemon loads the merged worktree-scope config; record any blocker precisely.

payload.problem: #8049 changes gopls-mcp-server to worktree scope, but #961 was closed before its required live workspace proof ran. Verify the current managed mcpx daemon and prove module API lookup, linked-worktree root selection, and distinct gopls instances from separate checkouts.
payload.priority_reason: Normal priority; a closed code issue left a production-relevant live proof unverified. The bounded follow-up provides the missing acceptance evidence without duplicating the completed config change.
evidence: PR #8049 changes the `.mcpx.json` gopls-mcp-server scope to worktree.
Issue #961 comment #6780423113 says the live proof was still owed because the daemon retained its pre-merge config.
#961 acceptance requires main-checkout API, linked-worktree root, and distinct per-checkout gopls instances.
Lane 2 closure pointer #13871 comment 7162914420; no separate live-proof issue existed before this follow-up.
acceptance: Record the daemon version/config source and show `go_package_api` returns the real module API from the main checkout.
Repeat the prompt from a linked worktree and record that gopls resolves its root to that worktree.
Run two callers from different checkouts and record distinct gopls instances and roots in `mcpx status`.
Use the managed config generation/deployment path if the daemon still loads a stale config; do not report evidence from an unrelated remote runner.
If a prerequisite prevents a live proof, record the exact blocker and route a separately scoped activation issue/task.
tests: Run the three read-only live gopls checks required by #961 on the daemon that serves the user environment; capture command/session evidence and outcomes.

issue.title: mcpx: complete gopls worktree live proof after PR #8049

include: Verify the current mcpx daemon/config source
Run gopls API prompt in main and linked worktrees
Record distinct per-worktree gopls instances and roots
exclude: changing gopls or mcpx implementation code unless a separately scoped blocker is found
using remote CI evidence that cannot reach the user daemon

dedupe.basis: Searched open issues for go_package_api, linked-worktree proof, and distinct gopls worktree instances; only closed source issue #961 matched. Existing Lane 2 pointer #13871#7162914420 has no live-proof task.
